stem.text: A manufacturer recommends that the longer the extension cord you use with an electric drill, the bigger the cross-sectional area of the cord should be.
What is a reason for this recommendation?

A.text: Resistance is inversely proportional to both the length and the cross-sectional area.

B.text: Resistance is inversely proportional to the length and directly proportional to the cross-sectional area.

C.text: Resistance is proportional to both the length and the cross-sectional area.

D.text: Resistance is proportional to the length and inversely proportional to the cross-sectional area.
